headline: President Lula Defends Government Fiscal Package Against Financial Sector Criticism
summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defended Brazil's spending proposals, rejecting criticism from financial institution leaders over fiscal policy.
why: Brazil's fiscal policies and public spending commitments heavily influence real interest rates, government bond yields, and the BRL exchange rate.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Fiscal policy debates between the presidency and market participants impact currency risk premiums.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Friction over Brazil's federal fiscal trajectory heightened market sensitivity around debt sustainability.
